plan.notes:
SEMESTER CREDITS: ATA College (El Cajon) states all credit values as semester credit hours (catalog course-table column "Sem. Credit Hours"). All credit values in this plan are semester credits, transcribed verbatim from the program course table in the official 2021 catalog.
Source: official ATA College (El Cajon, CA) 2021 Catalog filed with the California Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education (BPPE 2021 Annual Report filing). Newest official catalog located (atacollege.edu checked 2026-09-30 publishes only School Performance Fact Sheets, no newer full catalog).
Credential: Associate of Applied Technology (AAT), Information Systems & Communication Technology. The program offers three emphasis areas; the catalog states students are automatically enrolled in the IT Professional emphasis unless discussed with admissions, so this plan follows the IT Professional emphasis (FO 201/FO 202/FO 206/APL 205), whose module schedule is the one published in the catalog (Modules 10-11). The Fiber Optic Professional and Telecommunications Professional emphases are not collected here.
TERM GROUPING: the catalog publishes the program as 15 numbered modules (each ~4 weeks, 20 hours/week) with a fixed day/evening sequence; it does not publish Fall/Spring semesters. For the tracker's semester view, consecutive modules are grouped into 4 semesters; module order and boundaries are preserved verbatim (see each semester label).
CREDIT HONESTY: per-course credits come from the official course table. total_credits is the exact sum of those per-course values (66.35); the catalog header prints "65 Semester Credit Hours" and the course-table footer prints "PROGRAM TOTALS 1220 65" - the catalog's own arithmetic does not reconcile (course-table credits sum to 66.35). The catalog's module-schedule "Sem. Credit" column values are not used as per-course credits (e.g. Module 4 prints 4.79 for Computer Hardware while the course table value used here is 4.53).
CATALOG TYPO: the course table prints CT 115 Computer Hardware as "479" semester credit hours; treated as 4.53, consistent with every sibling 80-clock-hour course in the same table (CT 102/105/110/116/117/120 all 4.53 for 80 hours).
The catalog prints the four gen-ed modules as "MODULE 11" (duplicate of the earlier Module 11), 13, 14, 15 - skipping 12; they are renumbered here as Modules 12-15 in sequence with the content unchanged.

module_notes: GEN1:HIS 101+MS Word/Business Ethics: CPA 101 and BE 101 are listed in full here: the catalog's module schedule shows 20-hour "MS Word/Business Ethics", "MS PowerPoint/Business Ethics", "MS Excel I/Business Ethics" and "MS Excel II/Business Ethics" blocks spread across Modules 12-15, which together equal CPA 101 (40 clock hours) + BE 101 (40 clock hours). The catalog's printed gen-ed module numbers are "MODULE 11" (duplicate), 13, 14, 15 (skipping 12); renumbered here as Modules 12-15 in sequence.
